headline.en: Backend Software Engineer | Go · Node.js · TypeScript · AWS
headline.pt: Engenheiro de Software Backend | Go · Node.js · TypeScript · AWS

summary.en: Backend software engineer with 5+ years of experience building distributed systems for fintech: KYC and compliance engines and customer onboarding for Banking as a Service (BaaS). I work mainly with Go, Node.js, TypeScript and AWS, designing event-driven architectures with asynchronous processing, the outbox pattern and infrastructure as code (Terraform). AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.
summary.pt: Engenheiro de software backend com mais de 5 anos de experiência construindo sistemas distribuídos para fintechs: motores de KYC e compliance e onboarding de clientes para Banking as a Service (BaaS). Trabalho principalmente com Go, Node.js, TypeScript e AWS, projetando arquiteturas orientadas a eventos com processamento assíncrono, padrão outbox e infraestrutura como código (Terraform). Certificado AWS Solutions Architect – Associate.

detail.en: Moved into software during the degree, through a development internship.
detail.pt: Migrei para software durante a graduação, a partir de um estágio em desenvolvimento.
